text: In knowing nothing is the sweetest life.
author: Sophocles

archive.text: Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.
archive.author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

archive.text: Just as a well-filled day brings blessed sleep, so a well-employed life brings a blessed death.
archive.author: Leonardo da Vinci

archive.text: Faith is taking the first step even when you don't see the whole staircase.
archive.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

archive.text: You give but little when you give of your possessions. It is when you give of yourself that you truly give.
archive.author: Kahlil Gibran

archive.text: Stand up, be bold, be strong. Take the whole responsibility on your own shoulders, and know that you are the creator of your own destiny.
archive.author: Swami Vivekananda

archive.text: Change is coming, whether you like it or not.
archive.author: Greta Thunberg

archive.text: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.
archive.author: Zig Ziglar
